fields.name: Version
fields.about: The version of the voters record.

fields.name: Voters
fields.about: The set of voters in the quorum for this epoch.

fields.name: VoterId
fields.about: The replica id of the voter in the topic partition.

fields.name: VoterDirectoryId
fields.about: The directory id of the voter in the topic partition.

fields.name: Endpoints
fields.about: The endpoint that can be used to communicate with the voter.

fields.name: KRaftVersionFeature
fields.about: The range of versions of the protocol that the replica supports.

fields.name: MinSupportedVersion
fields.about: The minimum supported KRaft protocol version.

fields.name: MaxSupportedVersion
fields.about: The maximum supported KRaft protocol version.
